units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 2:3:3">Y. Orl. II, 62ᵃ</cite> <he>משום ש׳ ניכרת</he> (ed. Krot. once <cite ref="U00010"><he>שאובה</he></cite>) (the bath is disqualified) on account of the drawn water which is distinguishable (by its color).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 66a:8">B. Bath. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>מכלל דש׳ דאורייתא</he> this would indicate that the disqualification of a bath through an addition of drawn water is Biblical law.
